collection.title: SEAT Leon Estate 2014 to 2020 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the SEAT Leon Estate 2014 - 2020 will fit, this model requires a 26" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this SEAT Leon which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
